# A TypeScript function whose parameter is destructured has no name for it,
# so the parameter takes its position's, and the import builds: the binding
# pattern was handed to Node.Text, which panics over one.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off
sngl generate --platform=html --lang=go -o out app.sngl

-- app.sngl --
import lib "js:./lib"
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window {
    ui.text(value=string(lib.area(arg0={w=2, h=3})))
}
-- lib/index.ts --
export function area({ w, h }: { w: number; h: number }): number {
    return w * h;
}
